snippet.title: Exploding Ants Trailer - Empires of the Undergrowth DLC 1
snippet.description:
The exploding ants DLC is arriving on March 24! It comes with not only exploding ants (Colobopsis explodens), but also exploding termites (Neocapritermes taracua). 

Once you have the DLC they'll be available in your formicarium, in separate colonies for custom games, and in two extra levels that are twists on campaign levels (The Harvest - Firebreak, and Front Line - No Ant's Land). 

More details: https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/463530/view/496063443495814523

===================================
Empires of the Undergrowth is a real-time strategy game set in the world of ants! Now out on Steam, Epic Games Store, Itch.io and gog.
